------1.) DEP: FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
------2.) DEP: FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD

------4.) LNS: FactLoansRelationshipExposure
------5.) LNS: FactLoansOutstandingBalance
------6.) CCD: FactCardsRelationshipExposure

------9.) TRU: FactTrustFundValue
------10.) TRY: FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
------11.) SEC: FactSecurityPortfolio



---------------------------------------------
------1.) DEP: FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
--Balances comparison b/w BNKM and DW
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, D.DayOfYear, B.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull, B.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.PeriodEndDate
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimDate D ON D.DateSK = B.BusinessDateSK
    WHERE A.AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ---AND A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance > 100000
    ---AND A.CustomerAccountId = '06cf60dbc1e878b28caae830112d46b1'

SELECT COUNT(*), 'BNKM' FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27' UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*), 'DW' FROM dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127

------2.) DEP: FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
--Balances comparison b/w BNKM and DW
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.PeriodEndDate, A.BalanceAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull, B.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance' AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) BETWEEN A.PeriodStartDate AND A.PeriodEndDate
    AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ---AND A.BalanceAmount > 100000

SELECT COUNT(*), 'BNKM' FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance' AND PeriodStartDate = '2022-12-31' UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*), 'DW' FROM dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20221231

------3.) DEP: FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.PeriodEndDate, A.BalanceAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.BalanceAmountFull, B.BalanceAmountProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) BETWEEN A.PeriodStartDate AND A.PeriodEndDate
    AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ---AND A.CustomerAccountID = 'd002e13f67efbc77815e3596af1b6846'
    ---ORDER BY B.BusinessDateSK DESC


------4.) DEP: FactLoansRelationshipExposure
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.PeriodEndDate, A.BalanceAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.BalanceAmountFull, B.BalanceAmountProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) BETWEEN A.PeriodStartDate AND A.PeriodEndDate
    AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1


------5.) DEP: FactLoansOutstandingBalance
WITH Principal AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, DemandDate, SUM(DemandAmount) AS DemandAmount FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment 
    WHERE DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM' AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01' 
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, DemandDate
)
, Interest AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, DemandDate, SUM(DemandAmount) AS DemandAmount FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment 
    WHERE DemandFlowId = 'INDEM' AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01' 
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, DemandDate
)
, Penalty AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, DemandDate, SUM(DemandAmount) AS DemandAmount FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment 
    WHERE DemandFlowId = 'APDEM' AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01' 
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, DemandDate
)
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.DemandDate, D.DemandAmount AS Principal, E.DemandAmount AS Interest, F.DemandAmount AS Penalty
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.AmortizationAmount, B.InterestAmount, B.PenaltyAmount, B.OutstandingBalanceFull, B.OutstandingBalanceProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    ---SELECT TOP 10 * 
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, DemandDate FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01') A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactLoansOutstandingBalance B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.DemandDate
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    LEFT JOIN Principal D ON A.CustomerAccountId = D.CustomerAccountId AND A.DemandDate = D.DemandDate
    LEFT JOIN Interest E ON A.CustomerAccountId = E.CustomerAccountId AND A.DemandDate = E.DemandDate
    LEFT JOIN Penalty F ON A.CustomerAccountId = F.CustomerAccountId AND A.DemandDate = F.DemandDate
    WHERE convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.DemandDate AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1

SELECT CustomerAccountId, DemandDate, DemandFlowId, COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, DemandDate, DemandFlowId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT * FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE CustomerAccountId = '8fdf6c6b6390829986e7928ff8c1a306' AND DemandDate = '2018-10-30' AND DemandFlowId = 'APDEM'
SELECT * FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE CustomerAccountId = '585ab9d8f497162b68958999cc24c19c' AND DemandDate = '2020-10-26' AND DemandFlowId = 'INDEM'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(CustomerAccountId)) FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM' --- 183,384
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(CustomerAccountId)) FROM bnkm.RepaymentPlanPayment WHERE DemandFlowId = 'INDEM' --- 188,166

------6.) CCD: FactCardsRelationshipExposure
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount, A.OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.OutstandingBalanceAmount, B.OutstandingInstallmentAmount, B.RelationshipExposure
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.PeriodStartDate
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE C.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ---AND A.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount > 50000

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure

------7.) CCD: FactCardsOutstandingBalance
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate, A.RetailStatementBalanceAmount, A.CashStatementBalanceAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.StatementBalanceRetailAmount, B.StatementBalanceCashAmount, B.StatementBalance
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactCardsOutstandingBalance B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.PeriodStartDate
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE C.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ---AND  A.RetailStatementBalanceAmount > 10000

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dw.FactCardsOutstandingBalance

------8.) CCD: FactCardsCreditLimit
--Permanent Credit Limit
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.Timestamp, A.LimitAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.PermanentCreditLimit, B.CurrentCreditLimit
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactCardsCreditLimit B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.Timestamp
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE A.LimitTypeId = 'Permanent Credit Limit' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    AND B.PermanentCreditLimit != B.CurrentCreditLimit

--Credit Limit
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.Timestamp, A.LimitAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.PermanentCreditLimit, B.CurrentCreditLimit
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactCardsCreditLimit B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.Timestamp
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE A.LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit' AND C.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1
    AND B.PermanentCreditLimit != B.CurrentCreditLimit

------9.) TRU: FactTrustFundValue
WITH NonUITF AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp, SUM(BalanceAmount) AS AUMAmount FROM bnkm.NonUITFAUMBalance GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp
)
, UITF AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp, SUM(TotalBalanceAmount) AS AUMAmount FROM bnkm.UITFAUMBalance GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp
)
---SELECT CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp, SUM(AUMAmount) AS AUMAmount FROM (SELECT * FROM NonUITF UNION ALL SELECT * FROM UITF) AGG GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp
SELECT TOP 100
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.BalanceTimestamp, A.AUMAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.AUMAmountFull, B.AUMAmountProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp, SUM(AUMAmount) AS AUMAmount FROM (SELECT * FROM NonUITF UNION ALL SELECT * FROM UITF) AGG GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BalanceTimestamp) A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactTrustFundValue B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.BalanceTimestamp
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE C.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1


------10.) TRY: FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.[Timestamp], A.BalanceAmount
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.OutstandingInvestmentFull, B.OutstandingInvestmentProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId, [TimeStamp], SUM(BalanceAmount) AS BalanceAmount FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP' AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, [TimeStamp]) A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.[Timestamp]
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE C.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dw.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment

------11.) SEC: FactSecurityPortfolio
SELECT TOP 10
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.DateStamp, A.EndValue
    ,B.AccountID, B.BusinessDateSK, B.PortfolioEndValueFull, B.PortfolioEndValueProrated
    ,C.AccountStatus
    ---SELECT TOP 10 * WHERE CustomerAccountId = '35b4c9724e5c4c6a3dca17de348eee45'
    FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId, DateStamp, SUM(EndValue) AS EndValue FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, DateStamp) A
    LEFT JOIN dw.FactSecurityPortfolio B ON B.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountId AND convert(datetime, convert(char(8), B.BusinessDateSK)) = A.DateStamp
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount C ON C.AccountID = A.CustomerAccountID
    WHERE C.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND C.CurrentIndicator = 1


SELECT TOP 10 convert(datetime, convert(char(8), BusinessDateSK)), * FROM dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance WHERE AccumulatedCurrentBalance != 0 AND AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
